description: THE OPERATIONAL CAPABILITY CODEBOOK (fixes meta-gap 2). The composer's ShapeSignature codebook holds only ink-stroke/arrangement parts (the Omniglot arc), so 'bulk load of wikipedia' decoded as the handwriting LETTER 'a'. This seed installs an OperationalCapability node per operation the jabberwock can PLAN over — its OPERATIONAL vocabulary as referenceable graph parts. Each carries {name, aliases (verb phrases), binding_key (the boundary fn key), token_blob (curated discriminative content tokens for the overlap match)}. A separate faculty (capability_match, seeds/operational_planning.json) matches a clause to a capability by token-overlap Argmax over THESE nodes — so operational instructions reference operations, not ink.
